title: Forge application package target
description: Copies the Forge manifest and resources into the artifact directory and checks that the bundle is ready for Forge to ship.

outputPath.description: Output path of the generated files.

resourcePath.description: Path where resource files such as Custom UI output is placed relative to the outputPath.

resourceOutputPathMap.description: Map of resource project names to their respective output path.

allowMissingModules.description: Modules that the bundle may load although they are not in it, for optional requires that the code handles itself. A module name also covers its subpaths. The package target fails if the bundle loads any other module that is neither a Node built-in nor a file in the bundle folder.
